extDescription.message: Save a bookmark with any video

defaultFolderName.description: Default name of the bookmark folder on the bookmarks bar

optionsSubtitle.message: Adjust where bookmarks are saved and how video time is captured.

optionsIconDescription.message: Pick which icon to show in the toolbar.

optionsVideoOffsetDescription.message: Set offset in seconds. When saving a bookmark with a video, subtracts this value from the actual time watched

optionsMaxTitleLengthDescription.message: Maximum number of characters in the video title of a saved bookmark. Longer titles are truncated with "..."

optionsFolderDescription.message: Name of the folder where the bookmark is saved

optionsToastOffsetDescription.message: Left offset for the popup notification. Use a percent value such as 23.8%.

optionsReplacementsDescription.message: Replace text in the bookmark title. Replacements are applied top to bottom, before the title is truncated. Leave the second field empty to remove the text.
